t: This is Waterfall, a sculpture in London by Antony Donaldson. Donaldson was born in 1939 and worked in London from the beginning of the 1960s. He was a painter and a sculptor, and his work is associated with the Pop Art movement. He developed a visual interplay between abstract and popular imagery, and he is known for his paintings of fast cars and women. This piece belongs to that same restless way of looking, so see what you can find in its shapes and surfaces.
